workflow: Register a new patient and book a new-patient appointment

setup.command: npx tsx oe.ts login --user admin --pass pass

steps.command: npx tsx oe.ts create-patient --lname HACKDEMO-TR-{{HHMMSS}} --fname Maria --dob 1980-05-01 --sex Female
steps.verify: npx tsx oe.ts verify-patient --lname HACKDEMO-TR-{{HHMMSS}} --fname Maria --dob 1980-05-01

steps.bullet: Book a New Patient appointment next weekday 10:00
steps.command: npx tsx oe.ts book-appt --lname HACKDEMO-TR-{{HHMMSS}} --date next-weekday --time 10:00 --category 'New Patient'
steps.verify: npx tsx oe.ts verify-appt --lname HACKDEMO-TR-{{HHMMSS}} --date next-weekday --time 10:00
